newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields end down, underperform Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields end down, underperform Bunds.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Yields tracked falling European yields and ended lower. Swedish bonds underperformed, however, and the spread versus Germany widened three basis points to 96. Italian 10-year bond yields fell below their Swedish equivalents.

The crown gained to its strongest level since October 1996 against a generally weaker mark. The mark weakened against the dollar on growing expectations that the single European currency would be soft.
* Six month T-bill rate unchanged at 4.25 pct
* 10-year bond yield fell four basis points to 6.50 pct
* Crown firms to 4.3030 crowns against the mark versus 4.3325
